dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Never mind the dragon... Say, do you think that the ruins in Stormterror's Lair might contain some great treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Who knows? If I could nick a few priceless articles from within, I might not have to worry about money for the rest of my life, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: ...Or so I say, but I haven't the guts to go in there, even though the dragon's gone now...
